title: Getting started
content:
# Getting started

BPM Modeler supports **BPMN** for process models and **DMN** for decision models. The start screen offers one entry point for each model type and lists recently opened files; selecting one opens it in a new tab.

1. Choose a model type on the start screen or through **File → New**.
2. Or use **File → Open**.
3. Save with **Ctrl/Cmd+S**.

The status bar indicates whether all changes are saved.

title: Application interface
content:
# Application interface

![BPM Modeler with menu, document tab, BPMN palette, modelling canvas, and status bar](images/bpm-modeler-overview.png)

- **File**: create, open, and save models.
- **Export as**: create SVG files or PDF documentation.
- **Tools**: BPMN tools and DMN test cases.
- **View**: change the language.
- **Help**: open help topics.

Every opened model has its own tab. The BPMN palette is on the left.

title: Editing BPMN, DMN, and CMMN models
content:
# Edit models

Create a BPMN diagram, DMN model, or CMMN case model through **File → New**. Each opened model has its own tab. Use **Export as** to create SVG files or PDF documentation.

title: CMMN case models
content:
# CMMN case models

CMMN models case-based work. Select **Case models (CMMN)** on the start screen or **File → New → CMMN case model**. Open existing files through **File → Open → CMMN file** and save them as `.cmmn`.

Select a Process Task, Decision Task, or Case Task to link a local target model:

- **Process Task** links to BPMN.
- **Decision Task** links to DMN.
- **Case Task** links to CMMN.

A small arrow icon below every Process Task, Decision Task, and Case Task opens the link dialog, even when no link exists. Select the icon to set, replace, or remove a file path. With an existing link, **Open model** opens the target model in a new tab. Selecting the task itself does not open a dialog, so its label remains editable. **Tools → CMMN → Color element** and the context menu offer colours; **Default** restores the white fill with a black border. The context menu also offers **Copy**, **Cut**, and **Paste**. **Export as** creates SVG or PDF documentation with the diagram, case description, and linked tasks. On the first save and when exporting, the Case Plan Model name is used as the suggested filename; spaces, special characters, and umlauts are safely normalized.

title: Configure onboarding when opening models
content:
# Configure onboarding when opening models

Onboarding content is a normal help topic. To show an existing help topic when opening or creating a model, add the `onboarding` property to both the German and English version of that topic. Both entries must have the same stable `id`.

- `"onboarding": "bpmn"` displays the entry for BPMN diagrams.
- `"onboarding": "dmn"` displays the entry for DMN decision models.
- `"onboarding": "cmmn"` displays the entry for CMMN case models.

The topic remains available through **Help**. Its dialog uses the same Markdown rendering, language fallback, and global **Show onboarding when opening a model** setting. Without a marker for a model type, or when the global setting is disabled, no onboarding dialog appears.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
content:
# Keyboard shortcuts

## File

- **Ctrl/Cmd+N** – New BPMN diagram
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+N** – New DMN model
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+N** – New CMMN case model
- **Ctrl/Cmd+O** – Open BPMN file
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+O** – Open DMN file
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+O** – Open CMMN model
- **Ctrl/Cmd+S** – Save
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+S** – Save as

## Export

- **Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+S** – Export SVG
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+P** – Export PDF documentation

## BPMN

- **Ctrl/Cmd+C** – Copy selected elements
- **Ctrl/Cmd+X** – Cut selected elements
- **Ctrl/Cmd+V** – Paste elements
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R/B/G/Y/O** – Colour selected elements red/blue/green/yellow/orange
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+U** – Remove colour marking
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+R** – Define process scope
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+T** – Toggle token simulator

## CMMN

- **Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R/B/G/Y/O** – Colour selected elements red/blue/green/yellow/orange
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+U** – Remove colour marking

## DMN

- **Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+D** – Open DMN test cases
- **Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+I** – Include external DMN models

title: Help without an internet connection
content:
# Help without an internet connection

The help function works completely **offline**. Topics, search, and images are read from local files.

title: License and use
content:
# License and use

On first start, you must accept the MIT license terms. Until then, application functions remain locked. Find the full license text, author, version, disclaimer, and image credits for the AI-generated icons and the RheinWerk Verlag book cover in **Help → About BPM Modeler**. Use is at your own risk.
